name: manual_8141cd
claim: A run_in_background git push reporting 'completed (exit code 0)' does NOT prove main is clean or the remote matches — the exit code can come from an early stage of a chained command while a later 'git pull --rebase' or 'git commit' stalls interactively (e.g. mid-rebase waiting on rebase --continue, or a corrupted commit-msg hook). Always follow a backgrounded push with an explicit 'git status --short --branch' check before reporting sync as done.
conditions: background push exit code git status rebase verify before report done

decisions.notes: 2026-07-03: a background push task notified 'completed (exit code 0)' but the repo was actually stuck mid-interactive-rebase with an unresolved 727-line whole-file conflict in spawn_agents.py plus a CRLF-corrupted commit-msg hook (bash\r). The next session inherited a broken, unpushed main. Root-caused and fixed only when git status was checked directly instead of trusting the task summary.
